wall_scope: Only adjacent actual before-generation mtimes establish whole wall; includes checkpoint/seal/inter-outer work and excludes startup. No rank wall sum or candidate+step substitution. Missing next boundary means null.
phase_scope: Producer rounded log phases are preserved; checkpoint write is not all sealing time; segments need not sum to whole. Training EM/reward are not fixed-validation metrics.
counter_scope: FA3 and stop reports are actual cumulative counters per rank. Raw and retained token counts are kept distinct; null is not zero. Different policy/data/requests prevent strict speed causality.
